env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.label: GitHub token
env.hint: github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Fine-grained tokens: the release's repositories, Contents read-only

env.name: GITHUB_APP_ID
env.label: GitHub App ID
env.hint: Or your own GitHub App, installed on the repositories (Contents: read)

env.name: GITHUB_APP_KEY
env.label: GitHub App private key (.pem)
env.hint: Weave signs with it for the service; the service never sees it
